scares.description: DOOR KNOCKS MULITPLE TIMES
AXE BURST THROUGH THE DOOR - Maya wakes up
Closes her eyes when Ryan is beside her, opens her eyes and sees Scarecrow there and wakes up in Fright and loud noise
After the phonecall Maya can hear sounds and a scary event happening outside.
Sudden Volume increase and eerie music as Maya runs for the door then the lights go out
This scene is quite atmospheric eerie and spooky, Maya walking carefully with no sound around the hospital.
Scarecrow in the back moves privacy Curtain , loud noise
Scarecrow moves curtains Maya moved, the third one background sound appears
Maya runs into the small lift to escape PIN UP Appears with sounds
Scarecrow banging his axe on the cannisters to make a noise
After the eerie music stops, camera pans to Maya then Cannister gets knocked over in front of her
Scarecrow appears in the vents of the doors where Maya is hiding with sound, The Scene intensifies as Scarecrow is looking through the vent
Scarecrow swings his axe towards the guy and kills him
Hear Scarecrow footsteps and appears in scene with a small audioable alert and he watches Maya run off
As the women is standing there about to answer Maya, Crossbow bolt kills her by PIN UP
Horse gives Maya the sound cue to attack PIN UP with the pitch fork
Maya runs into the bathroom soon as she looks out the windows Scarecrow uses his axe to break into the door
Scarecrow makes a big enough hole to reach his arm in and grab Maya by the hair
shot shows a truck and Maya - Maya nearly gets hit by the truck
Two women in the truck lock the vehicle and causes Maya to hit a panic attack, screaming shouting, Let me out, Maya gets more and more scared during this moment.
Maya before this scene is sceptical about everyone in the car - As she looks at the guy on her right Scarecrow appears with sound
Maya looks into the main mirror of the car and see's PIN UP , everyone in the car has the MASKS, DOLL, PIN , Scarecrow
The scene intensifies more and more, Maya grabs the knife, unlocks the door and jumps out the car
Maya screams in pain as she attends her wound
Scarecrow walks towards the door that's padlock and strange animal is heard and more when he walks inside
Camera acting as the animal is heading towards Maya as shes by the camp fire, prior to this she hears a noise and looks around
Maya gets into the car and the animal shakes the car with a window glass breaking
After the silent moment the window smashes and car shakes, Maya screams
Car shakes again with the animal making a sound
Animal reveals itself "HOG" bursting through the car as Maya manages to get out
Maya thinks its safe to crawl on the floor, HOG rams her in the side
Maya fights with the hog and the Hog biting Maya's Leg
Maya finally gets up and stabs the hog multiple times
Young PIN UP kills Mouse/Rat in her hands, hear a squeak
Maya has a flash back of Scarecrow smashing the door with his AXE, Maya screams
Maya jumps out on the man inside the Airbnb with a knife
Man who is helping Maya, by the car grins at  Maya then Crossbow Bolt kills him in head with sound
Car Mechanic comes bursting underneath the car when the Ambulance man is walking around
Room Maya is in goes silent, she hears a noise then PIN UP Bust through the door at this time stamp
Maya is aware DOLL FACE is behind her as she sings a song, soon as Maya turns around Doll face stabs her suddenly
Maya gets in the ambulance, looks in the main mirror and see PINUP There, Pin UP tries to attack Maya
Maya stares at PINUP being stabbed and Scarecrow smashes the window making Maya scream
PINUP grabs Maya whilst driving
Maya reaches for PIN UP lying on the floor, music increases
Young Pin up hits the small blonde girl with a rock mutiple times.
Small trailer showing The Strangers Chapter 3 - hear screaming NO NO NO then Scarecrow swinging his axe in front of someone. Only scary bits in this small trailer.
